Package edu.bu.pas.hex.agents

Class TimedAgent

java.lang.Object
edu.bu.pas.hex.agents.TimedAgent
All Implemented Interfaces:
Agent
public final class TimedAgent extends Object implements Agent
Represents an Agent with a maximum amount of thinking time per move (e.g. per getAction call). This agent is a thin wrapper around another Agent: the only functionality this type provides is to run the internal Agent's getAction in a background thread and monitor for timeouts/exceptions. This agent will cancel the internal Agent's getAction if it takes too long and will return null so the Game will mark the timeout as a strike.

    • getMaxThiningTimeInMs

      public long getMaxThiningTimeInMs()
      Description copied from interface: Agent
      Returns the number of milliseconds that this agent is allowed to think for per move. If this agent takes longer than this budget of time to think (measured by getAction execution), the game will skip this agent's turn and mark a strike against this agent. If this agent accrues enough strikes then this agent will lose the game.
      Specified by:
      getMaxThiningTimeInMs in interface Agent
      Returns:
      The maximum amount of thinking time that this agent's getAction is allowed to run for.

      public Action getAction(GameView game)
      Description copied from interface: Agent
      Returns the Action this agent wants to take in this turn. The game loop will call this method until the game is solved. Must be a legal action to take or the Action will be discarded and a strike will be issued to this agent.
